tips.open: Shows the saved strategies to open.
tips.save: Saves the strategy and checks it. Saving always works, even with findings.
tips.check: Looks for problems such as missing connections or empty required entries.
tips.close: Closes the strategy. With unsaved changes Studio asks first.
tips.delete: Deletes the open strategy after confirmation.
tips.settings: Language and storage location of the objects.

library.title: Element library
library.hint: A click inserts an element after the selected step. You can also drag it onto the canvas.
library.loadFailed: The elements could not be loaded. Without them no strategy can be created or opened.
library.nothingFound: Nothing found. Try another search term.
library.storedFailed: The stored templates could not be read.

wizard.title: Assistant
wizard.leaveTip: The assistant has inserted everything up to here. You continue by hand.
wizard.nameText: What should the strategy be called? You can change name and description at any time.
wizard.triggerText: When should the strategy calculate? The trigger starts every evaluation.
wizard.asParameter: Create as strategy parameter (recommended: change the time unit in one place)
wizard.indicatorsText: Which indicators does the strategy need? They appear in the area "Objects and their values" of the drawing area.
wizard.noIndicators: No indicator yet. You can also skip this step.
wizard.conditionText: When should the strategy trade? Put together a simple condition. Finer conditions can be built later from blocks.
wizard.needTwoValues: A condition needs two values. Go back and create indicators, or skip the step.
wizard.orderText: What should happen on "true"? Choose the order here. Details such as the stop loss are set afterwards in the properties.
wizard.done: The setup is in place. The check shows what is still missing.
wizard.offerText: The assistant leads you to a first strategy in five steps: name, trigger, indicators, condition and order.

instances.ownParametersHint: Parameters that you define yourself. Expressions of this object address them by their name.

instances.propertiesHint: Properties that this object supplies. Each gets its value from an expression.

instances.ruleCheckHint: The rule checks: the expression is true or false.
instances.ruleDetermineHint: The rule determines a value: the expression gives the value of the property.
instances.noContained: Nothing contained yet. Choose below what is to be added.
instances.resultHint: Optional: an expression that forms the overall result from the results of the rules.
instances.noContent: This object has no content that you can change.

canvas.portValue: Drag from here to an element to connect this value

canvas.laneEmpty: Indicators, trends and market objects appear here. You connect their values with steps by lines.

canvas.orientVerticalTip: Flow vertical: entry on top, exits below
canvas.orientHorizontalTip: Flow horizontal from left to right, for wide screens

wiresTip.selection: Show only the value lines of the selected element

issues.syntax: Correct the spelling at the named position.

trigger.unconnected: Connect the trigger with the first step or remove it.

flow.not_reached: Connect a previous step or a trigger with this step or remove it.
flow.main_without_trigger: Add a trigger and connect it with the first step.
flow.unending_loop: Put a condition into the loop from which one output leads out of the loop.
flow.management_only: Move the step into the management of an order or remove it.
flow.no_order_reachable: Connect the flow with a step that places an order.

instrument.invalid: Correct the designation of the instrument.

data.unknown: Choose an object and a property that exist, or delete the connection.
data.type_mismatch: Connect a value of the fitting data type.

input.unused: Use the value in an expression or remove the input.

layout.invalid: Remove the section and create it again.

expression.order_outside_management: Use order and position only in the management of an order.

rule.unresolved_name: Check the name in the expression of the template.
rule.result_mismatch: Change the expression of the rule or choose another determined property.
rule.order_in_indicator: Remove the rule from the indicator or trend and assign it to the strategy or to an element.
rule.invalid_type: Remove the object from this list.

parameter.missing: Give the parameter a value, choose a strategy parameter or "at application".

order.property_missing: Assign the property or assign a rule that determines it to the element or the strategy.

ruleset.reference_order: Change the order of the rules so that each rule only uses earlier results.

candle.no_instance: Put a candle with a time unit on the canvas and use its values.

name.duplicate: Give one of the two another name.

type.unknown: Remove the element or install the extension that supplies the type.

trend.direction_missing: Enter the expression for the direction of the trend.

calculation.circular_reference: Change one of the calculations so that it does not lead back to itself.

findings.truncated: Fix the findings shown and check again.

connection.invalid: Delete the connection and draw it again.

element.rules_not_allowed: Remove the rules from this element.
element.management_invalid: Move the element into the main flow or into the management of an order.
